_rulescope_notes: Role for the lag workflow (PUT /api/security/role/rulescope-lag, or rulescope-lag-<space> per space). Keys starting with _rulescope are removed before sending.
The installer replaces __SPACES__ with ["*"] for the global scope, or ["<space id>"] for a per-space copy.

read on logs-* for the lag queries. read on rulescope-catalog-* for the catalog's rules, rule/data stream pairs (the LOOKUP JOIN) and syncs (the freshness check). The lag module never calls the rules API, so it needs no Security feature privilege.

Scheduled runs use the identity of the account that last saved the workflow, so give this role to a dedicated user and set RULESCOPE_LAG_WORKFLOW_API_KEY. That's why the role can create and update workflows (not delete).
manage_own_api_key lets the dedicated user create the API key that owns the workflow. It covers only that user's own keys.
